problem_found: Straight-line interpolation is a common fill mechanism (85 pure and 16 mixed fill items of 155) and is invisible to hold detection
fix: New state (eq. 21); A2/A3 cover holds **and** linear fills; new rules R19–R21

problem_found: F1–F3, F5–F7 are linearly filled over the same span: all 15 zones
fix: Episode EP056: A2, A2 → A1

problem_found: L is linearly interpolated during the B/F zeros
fix: A1 (0.93); no G1 left in the real data (R7 fires 0×)

problem_found: Zeros → straight line → zeros
fix: Re-segmented into 4 items

guide_item: Restoration ratio, ramp and overshoot (eq. 3, R1, R5, R7, H2)
problem_found: 21 % of dead runs restore through a synthetic straight line. C02's r = 0.22 was an artefact
fix: Measure after the ramp (D22). R5 turns out uninformative (log(a/b) = 0.12)

guide_item: Dead = x ≤ 5 % x̂ (eq. 4); v0 also required an exact zero
problem_found: v0 dropped exactly the noise-floor runs that H1 is about
fix: No exact-zero requirement

problem_found: Large events are compound (fill → zero), so one label per event cannot describe them
fix: Typed items (dead, fill, clock, transfer) linked into episodes

guide_item: R4: any step with one zone dead and another held
problem_found: A 1-h stuck sensor during a 108-h outage would vote A1
fix: Co-extensive = time IoU ≥ 0.5

problem_found: Fires on 18/33 dates, including Ramadan dates and fits with correlation 0.09–0.30
fix: Fit-quality guard (corr ≥ 0.9, gain ≥ 0.05) → 6 votes

problem_found: With single-label rules, θ = 1 for every class, so votes carry no information
fix: Abstention is an observed output (eq. 24)

guide_item: Unconstrained Dawid–Skene, "identifiable because most items get several votes"
problem_found: Most items get 1–3 votes and rules rarely co-fire. The model is unstable (63 % restart agreement) and loses class meaning
fix: Feasible classes by level, applicability domains, constrained one-coin parameters, defining-rule and π priors (eq. 24–26)

guide_item: Equal number of all-abstain N windows in the label model
problem_found: They add no information once classes are gated by level
fix: Deferred to the end model (NB3) as negatives

problem_found: The sign convention was not defined
fix: δ* < 0 means stamped earlier after the date; Oct 2022 = −60

problem_found: Laâyoune has a daily 30–50 min freeze in all zones (218 episodes) below the threshold
fix: Keep 6; sensitivity sweep; report as a finding

problem_found: v0 uses [d+1, d+14] vs [d−13, d]
fix: Documented; one-day shift, no effect on the C11 result

problem_found: v0 uses start hours 6–11 inclusive
fix: Documented (06:00–11:59)

problem_found: Not needed to test the hierarchy idea in NB3; heavy on CPU
fix: NB3 used LightGBM (Huber), the guide's own fallback (D39). NB4 implemented the TCN-GAT with a learned graph (D53); it became the main detector (D61), and the learned graph is presented as an ablation because removing it does not hurt detection (D67, F42)

guide_item: Eq. 13 graph nowcast (neighbours' current values) as the residual
problem_found: Adds nothing on clean data (MAE 0.0292 vs 0.0288); also does not absorb masked logger artefacts
fix: Forecast residual as main; the nowcast is kept as a comparison and a feature

guide_item: MODWT bands of ρ, one predictor per band
problem_found: Five predictors per zone. Causal coefficients smear events by up to 18 h
fix: MODWT of the residual, phase-aligned by measured group delays

guide_item: "An artefact on the logger moves the region part" (eq. 14 rationale)
problem_found: True for zero fills; false for holds and linear fills (zone-specific drift)
fix: Report hierarchy accuracy by kind; rules handle fills

guide_item: Eq. 15 robust z over the hierarchy parts
problem_found: A median over an odd number of zones makes one zone's v exactly 0; with these zeros in the scale estimate, the MAD collapses (B1, z = 15,182) and every small city's zone scores are inflated
fix: Exclude structural zeros from the median and MAD

guide_item: Detector adds coverage within the typology
problem_found: Detector-only anomalies are mostly outside it (partial outages, short interruptions, surges)
fix: Report them as untyped; propose typology extensions; ε sweep in NB4

problem_found: The end model cannot learn a class with one example out of fold (the G2 item flipped to G3)
fix: End-model abstention on classes with < 3 items of training mass

guide_item: One threshold rule (γ, gap) for every detector
problem_found: Event formation changes detector rankings more than the predictor does; a fixed rule favours some detectors
fix: Smoothing, percentile threshold and merge gap tuned per detector on separate development seeds, with the same budget for every detector

guide_item: Deep forecaster (PatchTST or N-BEATS) in the downstream test
problem_found: Heavy, and not needed to show that the effect does not depend on the model
fix: A model-free naive reference (persistence, seasonal naive) next to LightGBM

problem_found: Timestamps are kept as recorded throughout the study
fix: Clock items are excluded from scoring instead

guide_item: Tetouan: only the expected-value baseline is re-estimated
problem_found: A forecast-residual detector also needs predictor weights and a threshold on any new system
fix: Predictor weights and γ (frozen percentile) re-estimated from the unlabelled series as well; rules, label-model parameters and event formation frozen; every adaptation listed in docs/transfer_protocol.md
